data.name: Spirit Sense
data.description: You sense the presence of the unseen. You gain a +5 bonus on checks to notice haunts. In addition, when you target an incorporeal creature with a corporeal spell or effect that doesn't deal damage, you have a 75% chance of affecting the target. Normal: Corporeal spells and effects that don't deal damage have only a 50% chance of affecting an incorporeal creature.
